PR title:
Revert "Use shlex.quote for quoting shell arguments"

PR body:
This caused issues if the pager/editor command had options like `less -FRSX`, they would then get quoted as a single word rather than `less` then `-FRSX`.

`shlex.quote` doesn't seem to do the right thing on Windows cmd. Using `shlex.split` on the command first wouldn't help, as it would need to get re-joined and `subprocess.list2cmdline` is not an external API. Let's hold off until #1476 instead.

Reverts #1470
Closes #1514 

Gold patch (use only to infer the symptom; do not quote or describe the fix):

-    from pipes import quote as shlex_quote
-

         return isinstance(x, (buffer, bytearray))

     iteritems = lambda x: iter(x.items())

message.content: When using Click's pager or editor functionality, commands with multiple arguments (like `less -FRSX`) are incorrectly quoted as a single argument instead of being split into separate arguments, causing the pager or editor to fail to execute properly. On Windows, the quoting also produces incorrect results for command-line operations.
